candidates.citation: NBWC CR 25-16 — Washoe/Storey County, Truckee River

parameters.note: Open year-round except for closed waters (see closure rule); fishing hours any hour of the day or night.

candidates.summary: Truckee River (NV) is open to fishing year-round, any hour of the day or night, except the closed area at Derby Dam.

candidates.citation: NBWC CR 25-16 — Washoe/Storey County, Truckee River

parameters.counting_rule: Applies to the Truckee River generally (Washoe/Storey County), except the reach from E Mustang Road bridge downstream to the Pyramid Lake Paiute Reservation boundary, which carries a further trout sub-limit (see reach-scoped bag rule).

candidates.summary: Daily limit 3 game fish; possession limit 6 game fish (species composition unrestricted) on the Truckee River (NV) outside the special reach below.

candidates.citation: NBWC CR 25-16 — Washoe/Storey County, Truckee River (special reach)

parameters.counting_rule: Applies in the reach from E Mustang Road bridge (I-80 Exit 23) downstream to the Pyramid Lake Paiute Reservation boundary.

sub_limits.note: Of the daily/possession game-fish limit, only this many may be trout.

candidates.summary: In the reach from E Mustang Road bridge (I-80 Exit 23) downstream to the Pyramid Lake Paiute Reservation boundary: daily limit 3 game fish of which only 1 may be trout; possession limit 6 game fish of which only 2 may be trout.

parameters.note: Codified in NAC 503.504(3)(b)(5) as one continuous reach (E Mustang Road bridge to the reservation boundary) — no Derby Dam split appears in the NAC text; the separate CR 25-16 closed water at Derby Dam applies independently. Last amended by R082-23A, effective 2/9/2024.

candidates.summary: In this reach, only artificial lures with a single barbless hook may be used (no bait).

candidates.citation: NBWC CR 25-16 — Washoe County closed waters

parameters.note: No fishing within 1,000 feet downstream of Derby Dam.

candidates.summary: Truckee River closed to all fishing for 1,000 feet downstream of Derby Dam, year-round.

candidates.citation: NBWC CR 25-16 — Washoe/Storey County (no size-limit row for Truckee River trout)

parameters.note: No minimum or maximum size limit found for trout on the Truckee River (Washoe/Storey County) in NDOW's current fishing-seasons regulation; absence of a size-limit row for this water in that document is treated as a verified absence, not an oversight.

candidates.summary: No minimum or maximum size limit for trout on the Truckee River (NV) — verified absence.
